syntax: A placeholder is {name} where name matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$. Only the names listed here are replaced; any other {name} left in a deployed file is an error.

placeholders.name: project_name
placeholders.source: Folder name, editable in the setup dialog.

placeholders.name: project_summary
placeholders.description: One or two sentences on what the project is and who uses it.
placeholders.default: Describe the project here in one or two sentences.

placeholders.name: owner_title
placeholders.description: How the documents refer to the human who decides: product, releases, irreversible actions.

placeholders.name: primary_branch
placeholders.source: Detected from the repository HEAD, editable.

placeholders.name: verify_commands
placeholders.description: The commands that must pass before work is called done, one per line, as a fenced shell block body.
placeholders.default: # Add the type check, lint and test commands of this project here.
placeholders.source: Detected from the project manifest when possible (package.json scripts, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod), editable.

placeholders.name: language
placeholders.description: BCP 47 tag of the project language: the language agents write project content in (context, plans, tracking, handoffs, cards). Base files stay in English.
placeholders.source: Chosen when the folder is set up; defaults to the Voktty interface language.

placeholders.name: created_at
placeholders.description: ISO 8601 date of the first deployment.

placeholders.name: kit_version
placeholders.description: Version of the template the project was created from.

placeholders.name: default_runtime
placeholders.description: Adapter id used by agents that do not choose one. See team/agents.schema.json.
placeholders.source: Agent selected in Voktty at deployment.

placeholders.name: default_model
placeholders.description: Model id for the default runtime. Empty means the runtime's own default.
placeholders.source: Model selected in Voktty at deployment.
